summary: You have three branches and 14 named doctors, but the homepage shows placeholder numbers and sends patients to a test page when they try to book.

findings.problem: Branch statistics show placeholder digits (+ 0123456789001234567890.0123...). The Google Reviews heading has no reviews and Listed below for our doctors has no list.
findings.cost: Placeholder numbers and empty sections look broken and give no proof.
findings.fix: Real branch details, a live review wall and a doctor list.

findings.problem: Click here to book an appointment points to test2.dohadentalcenter.com. Our Services and both Read More buttons link to #. The WhatsApp us label has no number.
findings.cost: Patients who try to book land on a test site or nowhere, so bookings are lost.
findings.fix: One tested booking path and a real WhatsApp button.

findings.problem: The logo loads from a demo theme domain. Copy has errors such as valid only four our newsletter subscribers and Al Kharaitiyat zoon 71.
findings.cost: Template leftovers and typos weaken trust in a medical brand.
findings.fix: Own logo files and proofread copy.

findings.problem: The patient claim jumps from more than 80,000 to nearly a thousand a year, the name appears three ways, there are no before and after or testimonials, and the footer says 2023.
findings.cost: Conflicting numbers and no proof lose careful patients.
findings.fix: Consistent facts, results gallery and current copy.

redesign: A working booking form and WhatsApp button for each branch.
A live review wall, doctor profiles and a before and after gallery.
